Vacancy for Senior Residents / Tutors
Saturday, 07 March 2026
1417 Hits
Applications in the prescribed proforma (
available here
) with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification are invited for the below mentioned posts.
Senior Residents / Tutors in the department of Anatomy, Biochemistry, Physiology & Forensic Medicine.
Qualification / Experience:-
Senior Residents-
MD/ MS/ DNB in above mentioned subjects as per NMC & MUHS norms.
Tutors:
MBBS or M.Sc. in Medical Anatomy / Physiology / Biochemistry from a recognized University / Institute.
Salary:
As per Kasturba Health Society’s Rules
Age Limit
: upto 45 years of age.
Note:
1. Application to be submitted to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences,   PO Sevagram Dist Wardha 442102 for the post of Senior Resident / Tutor
latest by 15/3/2026.
Only eligible candidates will be called for document verification / Interview
Decision of Selection Committee will be final and binding.
Competent appointing authority reserves right to reject any or all applications.
